aliases: gene-level analysis of Affymetrix exon microarrays

evidence.quote: RNA expression for the in vivo study and one in vitro study was analyzed using the Human Exon ST 1.0 microarray platform (Affymetrix) essentially as described in ref. 17.

additional_evidence.readouts: RNA expression profiles in peripheral blood mononuclear cells

evidence.quote: RNA from the MRKAd5 vs. YF-17D comparative in vitro study was analyzed using the Agilent SurePrint G3 Human GE 8 × 60K microarray platform (Agilent Technologies), essentially as described in ref. 17.
Quantitative real-time PCR was performed as described in ref. 17.
Serum cytokine analysis was performed using the Lincoplex High Sensitivity kit

name_in_paper: Enumeration and Phenotyping of Fresh Blood Cell Populations

evidence.quote: Cells were ﬁxed with PBS containing 1% paraformaldehyde and stored at 4 °C until analysis by ﬂow cytometry.
